note: CFAT decisions log. Shown and edited on the planner: Lesson planning > CFAT planning. Newest first.
rules: 20-minute formative, one double-sided A4 sheet max.
1 CFAT = 1 week = 3 x 79-min lessons; the CFAT sits after the last lesson on its subchapters.

One question per checklist skill. Levels: 10MAG = L1 (Level 9 review) + L2 (Level 10); 10MAA = L2 + L3. Odd skill -> lower level, even -> higher; 10A subchapters take the higher level; short weeks (<6 skills) test both levels per skill.
Code = unit.chapter.CFAT number (unit = position in that stream's unit list).
Questions verbatim and cited (solutions copy only); adapt only when unavoidable and label it 'adapted'. Don't reuse questions from worksheets, slides or exit tasks.
Layout: title box; Section A MC in 2 columns with options A-E vertical (never a single MC); Section B short answers full width; sketch questions get a blank grid beside them.
Multiple equations in a stem go one per line, labelled [1], [2]. No sources or skill tick table on the student copy.

decisions.decision: 10MAG Modified: every 10MAG CFAT gets an M version (same week and skills, Year 7-8 level, code + M, e.g. 1.9.1M). Modified lessons/workbooks use Freefall 7/8/9 sheets mapped per subchapter (courses/modified.json), checked and approved per unit on the planner; workbooks built on G: only (Freefall licence). Gaps (trig, parabolas, networks, recursion, simultaneous eqns, conditional prob) decided unit by unit and logged here.
CFAT 1.9.1 = 9A-9C, CFAT 1.9.2 = 9D-9E. L1 from Cambridge 9 Ch 9 (else Cambridge 8 Ch 8), L2 from Oxford 10 (else Jacaranda 10). L3 not used.
Rewording a stem so a single part stands alone, or adding an instruction such as 'graph the solution on a number line', is OK if labelled 'adapted' in the source.
CFAT code changed to unit.chapter.CFAT number. Existing CFATs renamed only: 10MAA 1.1.1-1.1.4, 10MAG 3.1.1-3.1.5.
5 CFATs: 1A-1C, 1E-1F, 1G-1H, 1I-1J, 1K-1L (no 1D). Adjacent sketch questions sit side by side with smaller grids; spare space capped at 22 mm per mark.
4 CFATs built: 1.1.1 = 1A-1D, 1.1.2 = 1E-1F, 1.1.3 = 1G-1L, 1.1.4 = 1I-1K (as named in the files).
1 CFAT = 1 week = 3 lessons (classes get 3 lessons a week); CFAT groupings chosen for similar content.
